The '''Current Index to Statistics''' was an online database published by the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] and the [[American Statistical Association]] that contained bibliographic data of articles in [[statistics]], [[probability]], and related fields. It was shut down at the end of 2019.<ref>{{cite web|accessdate=2019-01-03|title=CIS - Current Index to Statistics|url=https://www.statindex.org/|website=www.statindex.org|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190104072821/https://www.statindex.org/|archive-date=2019-01-04|url-status=dead}}</ref>
